description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinarySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, SharedSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for use within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external method references related to thread synchronization and inter-process communication.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion via platform-specific critical sections or mutexes.

classes.name: BinarySemaphore
classes.description: A class implementing a binary semaphore for thread synchronization.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A class implementing a counting semaphore for managing access to a resource with a maximum count.

classes.name: SharedSemaphore
classes.description: A class for inter-process semaphore sharing, supporting named and shared memory semaphores.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A class representing an event object for thread signaling, supporting manual and auto-reset modes.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template utility class for RAII-style locking of synchronization objects.
